This release contains breaking API and storage-format changes. Read the upgrade notes before updating an existing application or database.
`SledStorage` is deprecated in v0.20.0 and is planned for removal in v0.21.0 ([#2013](https://github.com/gluesql/gluesql/pull/2013)). Existing deployments can continue using it during the v0.20 release cycle, but new persistent deployments should use `RedbStorage`.
GlueSQL v0.20.0 makes the Rust core synchronous, introduces `StatementPlan` and a typed query execution pip

## ✨ Highlights

### Indexed placeholder parameter binding

glue.execute_with_params(

).await?;

// SELECT with parameter
let rows = glue
    .execute_with_params(
        "SELECT name FROM users WHERE id = $1",
        glues

- Added coverage for Redis alter-table errors and MockStorage schema fetch failures ([#1715](https://github.com/gluesql/gluesql/pull/1715), [#1751](https://github.com/gluesql/gluesql/pull/1751)).
- IndexedDB storage now guards against `Arc::try_unwrap` panics when multiple connections are open ([#1718](https://github.com/gluesql/gluesql/pull/1718)).
- Fixed IndexedDB multi-connection crash mentioned above ([#1718](https://github.com/gluesql/gluesql/pull/1718)).
- Redis storage depends on `redis` 0.32 and re

- Changed the default database provider to PostgreSQL while retaining explicit SQL Server support
- Added Docker Compose health checks for the web application and PostgreSQL, with web startup gated on database health
- Improved public search with case-insensitive matching across titles, abstracts, keywords, tags, and categories on both supported database providers
- **Database migration required:** v16.7.0 makes `CommentReply.CommentId` non-nullable and updates the comment-reply foreign key to use cascading

- **No database migration required:** v16.5.0 does not introduce database schema changes.
- Improved database startup ordering so automatic migration runs before configuration initialization reads or writes
- Changed `AutoDatabaseMigration=false` to skip migration and database-version checks, leaving database compatibility to the operator
- **Automatic database upgrade:** In `Production`, `AutoDatabaseMigration=true` continues to run the cumulative provider migration before configuration initialization. Whe

- **Database migration required:** v16.4.0 adds the `SiteVerificationFile` table and migrates persisted UTC timestamp columns. It also converts `PostViewDaily.ViewDateUtc` to a database `date` column and removes the legacy `LoginHistory` table.
- Added a database readiness endpoint at `/health/ready`, while keeping `/health` as a liveness-only endpoint
- **Back up before upgrading:** The timestamp migration changes database column types and rebuilds affected indexes and keys. Take and verify a database back
